files.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: epic dragon catalogue card artwork, full-bleed opaque landscape 5:3. Create a completely new original composition from this text. Sophisticated colorful fantasy storybook illustration in brushed gouache and watercolor, mature powerful creatures with fine ink-like contours and richly textured individually painted scales. The main dragon dominates 65–80% of the composition. Make the horns, heads, limbs and wing silhouettes easy to read in a small card crop. Crisp creature edges and detailed scales contrast with calmer softer epic atmospheric scenery, with strong value and warm/cool contrast. Ferocious imposing mature creature, dynamic forceful pose, visibly sharp teeth/claws without violence or gore. No people, no other creatures, no lettering, text, watermark, frame, photograph, 3D render, modern objects or excessive scenery clutter. Scene: pale coral rocky SEA CLIFFS over a quiet silver sea with sea spray and soft pink mist, simple distant pale coral cliff silhouettes and a light hazy sky. Subject: one MASSIVE EMERALD-BLACK WYVERN with jagged swept-back long dark horns, thick heavily armored scales, glowing acid-gold eyes, a broad brutal wedge-shaped dragon head BARING LARGE FANGS in a threatening snarl. A hulking distinctive individual with muscular chest, long ridged neck, sharp dorsal spikes, hooked heavy tail. It is braced on the coral cliff, two powerful hind feet gripping the rock, chest thrust upward and forward, huge wings sweeping out in a dominating aggressive display. ANATOMY IS ESSENTIAL: exactly TWO HIND LEGS and exactly TWO wing FORELIMBS, for FOUR LIMBS TOTAL. Each front limb IS a leathery wing with a bent arm bone, wing fingers, membranes and a small visible wing thumb. Absolutely NO separate front legs or extra clawed arms beneath the chest. Both enormous emerald-black wings are distinct and their translucent deep jade membranes remain clearly visible across the top/back of the composition. Keep both hind legs, head, horns and wing thumb joints identifiable, wing tips within or nearly within frame. Dark emerald body strongly separates from pale light coral sea cliffs, subtle cool jade edge highlights and a soft warm pink rim light. Badass threatening apex predator, no breathing fire, no gore.
